title: From cell tower location to user location: Understanding the spatial uncertainty of mobile phone network data in human mobility research
authors: Xiangkai Zhou; Linlin You; Shuqi Zhong; Ming Cai
abstract: Mobile phone network data is a vital source for unveiling human mobility characteristics in accordance with its large-scale spatiotemporal trajectory information. However, mobile phone network data usually records location at the level of cell towers, lacking accurate individual locations. Therefore, the authenticity and credibility of the conclusions drawn from such data are often questioned due to the spatial uncertainty. In this paper, we evaluate the location differences between users and the cell towers during connection establishment. Furthermore, we delve into the representation and contributing factors of spatial uncertainty, including cell tower density, antenna status, and user mobility. Our analysis is based on one-month mobile signaling data and taxi GPS data collected in Foshan (a prefecture-level city in China), which represent two forms of data on the mobility of the same individual. We conclude that to estimate user positions, areas significantly larger than the nearest cell tower are necessary. The influence of tower density and antenna load on connection accuracy does not exhibit a straightforward linear dependency; instead, it fluctuates once a threshold is reached. Connection accuracy is typically higher when users are stationary than when they are in motion. Our findings together indicate that it should carefully assess the accuracy of position estimation when mapping from cell tower location to user location.
abstractZh: 移动通信网络数据包含大规模时空轨迹信息，是揭示人类移动特征的重要来源。然而，这类数据通常仅记录基站层面的位置，缺乏精确的个体位置。因此，由空间不确定性导致的研究结论真实性与可信性常受到质疑。本文评估用户建立连接时与基站之间的位置差异，并进一步探讨空间不确定性的表现与影响因素，包括基站密度、天线状态和用户移动情况。分析基于中国地级市佛山市采集的一个月手机信令与出租车GPS数据，两者以不同形式记录同一个体的移动。研究发现，要估计用户位置，需要考虑显著超出最近基站范围的区域。基站密度和天线负载对连接准确性的影响并非简单线性关系，而是在达到一定阈值后出现波动。用户静止时的连接准确性通常高于移动时。这些发现共同表明，从基站位置映射到用户位置时，应审慎评估位置估计的准确性。
summary: 基站观测位置与用户真实位置的不确定性
